meta.title: A surrogate bid for a vendor who already bid is refused by default

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “A bid is already placed on behalf of this company.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: A surrogate bid for a vendor who already bid is refused by default

expected.message: A bid is already placed on behalf of this company.
